name: Morwen Estate
storyline:
Step into the shoes of Detective Ryan McMillan, a seasoned investigator drawn to a chilling case deep in the backwoods of Knoxville. What begins as a missing persons investigation quickly spirals into something far more sinister.

Trapped inside a decaying estate filled with cryptic clues, long-forgotten secrets, and restless echoes of the past, McMillan must unravel the truth before it consumes him. Every room hides a piece of the puzzle, every artifact tells a story, and not all spirits have found peace.

Will you piece together the mystery—or become a part of it?
summary:
The case was cold. The house was colder.

Detective Ryan McMillan’s investigation into a string of missing persons cases brings him to the isolated Morwen Estate. But when a sudden blow leaves him unconscious, he awakens in a dark, damp basement—surrounded by cryptic clues and the restless spirits of the lost.

To escape, McMillan must explore the eerie estate, uncovering the tragic stories of those who vanished. Every room hides secrets. Every item left behind is a key to the truth. But as the past resurfaces, something far darker watches, waiting for its next victim.

The truth is buried, but escaping may cost you everything...
